item.title: Koe turns back time, reaches Brier final with 9-7 win in an extra end over Dunstone
item.description: ST. JOHN'S — Kevin Koe may be a four-time Canadian men's curling champion, but he acknowledged his team was an underdog heading into the Montana's Brier this year.

item.title: 'Expansive and experiential': Vancouver International Auto Show to showcase over 200 vehicles
item.description: The annual event has over 300,000 square feet of exhibitor space.

item.title: Ravens, Gaiters to meet in U Sports men's basketball final
item.description: CALGARY — Cedric Mbiaba had 19 points and nine rebounds to lead the Carleton Ravens to a 58-52 victory over the Toronto Metropolitan Bold on Saturday in the U Sports men's basketball semifinals in Calgary.

item.title: Diallo upsets Rublev at Indian Wells, faces fellow Canadian Auger-Aliassime next
item.description: INDIAN WELLS — Gabriel Diallo of Montreal dropped the first set 6-7 (4) then bounced back with 7-6 (1), 6-3 wins to upset Andrey Rublev in the second round of men's singles at the Indian Wells Open on Saturday.

item.title: Farabee leads Flames to 5-4 win over Hurricanes
item.description: CALGARY — Joel Farabee scored twice, including his team-leading 15th goal, and had an assist to lead the Flames to a 5-4 NHL victory over the Carolina Hurricanes on Saturday.

item.title: Whitecaps topple Timbers 4-1 in Cascadia Cup rivalry match
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Brian White scored twice and the Vancouver Whitecaps beat the rival Portland Timbers 4-1 on Saturday night in a Cascadia Cup rivalry match.

item.title: Canadian women look to reframe rugby sevens identity
item.description: VANCOUVER — Nearly two years after winning silver at the Paris Olympics, Canada’s women’s rugby seven squad is in what head coach Jocelyne Barrieau describes as a "framing year." “Last year was our foundational year,” she said Saturday.

item.title: Senators pull away with four-goal spree, beat Kraken 7-4
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Shane Pinto had a goal and two assists in Ottawa's four-goal spree in the first and second periods and the Senators beat the Seattle Kraken 7-4 on Saturday night.
